subject.title: Conversational agent lane wedges indefinitely: ingress events never reconcile (re-delivery storm on reconnect) + abort_embedded_run leaves owner lock unreleased (released=0)

question: Should the remaining durable ingress replay half be resolved by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99365's bounded replay/dead-letter and public SDK surface, or should that policy/API be narrowed before merge?
rationale: The code path for Bug 2 remains on main, but the candidate fix makes message-delivery and public Plugin SDK contract choices that automation should not decide for maintainers.

options.title: Review and land PR 99365
options.body: Accept the bounded WhatsApp replay/dead-letter policy and public durable replay helper as the intended fix for the remaining issue.

options.title: Narrow the candidate PR
options.body: Keep the issue open while the PR removes or internalizes the public SDK surface or changes the replay cap before merge.

options.title: Split operator tooling
options.body: Land the replay fix separately and track inspect/drain/ack CLI tooling as a narrower product-approved follow-up.

recommendation.title: Review and land PR 99365
recommendation.body: Accept the bounded WhatsApp replay/dead-letter policy and public durable replay helper as the intended fix for the remaining issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The open PR already requests his review for the message-delivery side, and history ties him to channel retry and delivery surfaces.
